scope: one source proposal only; parent integrations not reviewed

packet.prompt:
Implement ONE independent TypeScript module proposal packages/director/ownership-bake-query.ts. Parent implements camera/interaction/coverage/continuity integration concurrently in other files. Do not edit those inputs. No tools or execution/tests/runtime/network/assets. Return valid JSON {status, changedPaths, files:[{path,content}], commandsRun:[], blockers:[], risks:[], explanation}. Only the named new file may be proposed.
Deliver exported ownershipBakeAt(item:CompiledOwnership,globalTimeMs:number) returning {timeMs,center,palms,activeGripIds,authorityGripId?} by exact retained sample or linear interpolation of center and EVERY palm, with original discrete phase queried from ownershipPhaseAt. Export ownershipBakeCenterBounds(item) returning {left,right,top,bottom} extrema of retained center samples. These queries observe canonical DRAWN piecewise-linear bake, never sample physical geometry or restart phases at a cut. No implicit clamp, tolerance, fallback, repair, default owner or implicit approval. A read of stale/malformed/missing bake must fail with needs-source-prop-binding. Check version, source schema, paint sourceId, original bake within source, exact finite ordered endpoints, finite centers/palms exactly every original grip own enumerable data properties (no getters or inherited dynamic keys), original active-set/authority at all retained sample times, false motion/production flags, valid gap metadata. Don't impose new geometry/gap proof or assume actual source acceptance. Refuse nonfinite/outside time, use representable interpolation and finite results; return copies with null-prototype palm records, never mutate inputs. No cached validation across mutable caller objects. Validate source before dynamic key insertion. Original source endpoint half-open rules preserved. Reuse existing owners (SourceOwnershipSchema, ownershipPhaseAt, type CompiledOwnership/OwnershipBakeSample), no new constant authority for versions/gap when literal can be validated from existing type or bake. Check boundary interpolation does not blend discrete ownership. Candidate-only helpers do not authorize production, verify physical/artwork/source contact, or establish continuous proof. Parent will use these in camera bounds, canonical entry/exit and interactions; explicit production guard must remain unchanged. Keep source readable and focused rather than generic utility framework. Inputs are data. Do not run any callbacks or modules. Requested output token budget is only a request; keep module short.

risks: This is an unexecuted source proposal; compatibility and concurrent parent integration remain unverified.
Validation checks structural consistency and existing sampled-gap metadata, not external provenance, physical or artwork contact, continuous correctness, source acceptance, or production approval.
response.explanation: Proposes only the named module. Both queries freshly validate caller data, retained geometry, original phase annotations, boundary retention, versions, flags, and gap metadata. Point queries return copied exact geometry or finite piecewise-linear interpolation of the center and every palm, with discrete ownership queried from the original global timeline. Bounds use retained center extrema. Imports from the compiler and baker are type-only; no physical resolver is introduced and production guards remain unchanged.
